kit.note: Proposed kit price, not a Mundo Perfil price. The configurator takes this share off the catalogue total, then adds VAT. 41 % makes the Esencial build (the default cockpit without a monitor stand, 490.04 EUR at catalogue price) cost 349.84 EUR with VAT, about the 350 EUR that comparable commercial rigs cost (Homes, 2026-10-24). The parts list keeps catalogue prices.

black.note: Mundo Perfil lists no black CS10 profile (only a 40x40 with a 6 mm slot). The configurator offers black profiles at the natural price until they confirm one. Black 40x80 brackets are listed; black end caps are listed without a price, so the grey price is used.
